name: Drunks
overview: Scripture warns believers against the dangers of drunkenness, describing wine as a deceiver that leads to unwise behavior and urging Christians to live honorably without indulging in excess or riotous living. Instead of being controlled by strong drink, believers are called to be filled with the Spirit, demonstrating transformation through the renewing of the mind and walking in a manner consistent with God's perfect will. Drunkenness is listed among works that disqualify one from inheriting the kingdom of God, highlighting the serious spiritual consequences of such conduct. The believer is also encouraged to receive those weak in faith without judgment, fostering unity while maintaining a holy standard.
